fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stench Shot
fusions.desc: Spits a stinking glob that deals 28 damage, ignores the target's resistances and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Left Alone
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lingering Reek
fusions.desc: When your health runs low, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 4.5 tiles, dealing 12 damage. Once every 45 seconds.
